Open About, Help & Update → Software update. The app checks this ROM's saved/publisher source automatically; it does not download or install without your choice.

The screen shows your version, the new version, download size and release notes. Choose Download, wait for verification, then choose Install. B returns while a download continues; open Update again to see progress. A on the first row cancels a running check/download.
Install stops music and closes the app. Reopen NXT Retro Music. Your profiles, preferences, favorites, history and credentials stay outside the replaced app folder; a previous-app backup is saved.

Update source lets you enter a public update.json FILE link, import that link from a .txt/.url file or restore the publisher source. Folder links are not manifests. Stock and NextUI use separate sources and target checks.

For future releases, use Manage versions → Upload new version on the same update.json file to keep its ID/link. Update version, ZIP download_url, size and sha256 from the new installer. The Stock JSON must keep rom=stock; NextUI needs its own JSON file/link.

The app verifies package, ROM, device, ZIP size, SHA-256, archive paths and ARM64 binaries. Use your trusted publisher's source; the manifest is unsigned. Keep power connected while installing. If interrupted, restore Apps/.NXT_Retro_Music.previous. On sharing/quota/download errors, export NXT_App_Log.txt from About START.

v1.8 Big Update: 36 full-screen native interfaces with distinct palettes, fitted album art, live lyrics, queue count and visible button hints.
Shuffle, repeat Off/One/All, sleep countdown, volume, source quality and actual output are visible in the player.
Each listener has a saved avatar on the startup chooser. Choose today's mood, genre and country for Personal suggestions.
300 icons and 180 3D emoji, plus your photo or letters. Old pixel avatar selections migrate to an icon.
Six searchable settings groups, sectioned guides, Spring Thong credits and PayPal support.
On-demand Wi-Fi transfer with a session PIN, progress and cancellation. USB-C transfer uses the firmware storage screen after normal app cleanup.
14 system languages. English is the first-run default; matching offline keyboards include Vietnamese Telex, Hangul, Japanese kana/kanji and Chinese Pinyin candidates.
Bounded image/text caches, separate animation budgets and no hidden-screen drawing or FFT. LED color and mode changes apply immediately.
Start by choosing or creating a listener. Personal has four tabs: For you, Statistics, History, Profile. L1/R1 switches tabs.
Personal → Profile → Personal appearance: theme, RGB, fonts and unified Wallpaper gallery. Online images and JPG/PNG from SD are in the same place.
Wallpaper gallery: L1/R1 changes five tabs; D-pad/analogs selects; L2/R2 pages; START chooses online source or built-in offline backgrounds.
A opens and loads the full picture, A again previews the home menu. X saves offline/applies, Y favorites; L2 in picture detail switches Smooth / Preserve pixels.
In menu preview, left/right changes panel opacity, SELECT toggles dark/light, A saves to this listener and B cancels. Prefer 15–35% cover to show more wallpaper.
SD images: place JPG/PNG in Pictures/Wallpapers or browse another folder. Images up to 10 MiB and 16 million pixels; background is prepared for the 1024×768 display. Downloads work offline.
Online gallery: 24 categories; scroll beyond the last result or R2 to load more pages. Reopen and reapply older downloaded pictures to refresh their quality cache.
Statistics: left/right changes period; Y opens details. History: up/down selects a track; A plays; L2/R2 pages. Profile: edit nickname/24 icons or open personal appearance.
OTA Stock: the publisher source is built in. Open Update to check automatically; see notes, download/verify, then confirm install. B returns while downloading; reopen after successful installation.
About START exports NXT_App_Log.txt; recording can be disabled per profile. Listening counts after 30 seconds or half of a shorter track.
